hook: FusionQ decodes quantum errors in local pieces and matches the exact global answer on every shot.
summary: Quantum error decoders usually wait for a full block of syndrome data. FusionQ decodes small regions around triggered detectors as data arrives and fuses them, with a proof that an exact local solver gives the global most likely error. It cuts latency across decoder types, though the evaluation appears to be in simulation rather than on hardware.
title: FusionQ: A Generic and Optimal Decoding Framework for Ultra-Low-Latency Quantum Error Correction
